placements.title: Settling adoption by declaration
placements.frame: How is a technology adoption performed as already settled — declared with quantified rationale and concrete migration timeline — rather than proposed or deliberated?
placements.why: Both expressions enact the Zypherion adoption as accomplished fact: src-1 declares it in present tense ('we are adopting'), src-2 records it under 'Key decisions' with a 15x columnar-query performance justification and a Q3 2026 migration timeline. The theme — how this org settles technology adoption by declarative finality backed by quantified evidence — is a subject future envelopes will keep feeding, not a one-time fact.
